description:
List the people this number has exchanged messages with.

Filter by `phone` or by `name`. They are separate filters, not one
search box: `name` matches the contact's name, `phone` matches the
number.

`source` restricts to how the contact first appeared: `inbound` (they
messaged this number), `outbound` (this number messaged them),
`mention` (named in a group message) or `self` (the number's own
contact card).

`contacted_in_cycle=true` narrows the list to exactly the people
counting against this number's contact quota this billing cycle: those
messaged through Turbo Notify inside the cycle, whether newly or again.
Use it to see what the quota gauge is actually counting.

contacted_in_cycle.description: When true, return only the people who count against this number's contact quota in the current billing cycle: those messaged through Turbo Notify inside the cycle, new or returning. Use it to see exactly what the quota figure is counting.
contacted_in_cycle.title: Contacted In Cycle

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Pass back the `cursor` from the previous response, with the same filters; omit it for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: How many items to return, 1-200. Defaults to 50.
limit.title: Limit

number_alias.description: Which of the organization's WhatsApp numbers this acts on: `main`, the alias of an extra number, or the number's `id` (`num_…`), which stays the same when the alias is renamed. Call `list_numbers` to see them. Defaults to the main number.
number_alias.title: Number Alias

phone.description: Only contacts whose phone number matches.
phone.title: Phone

source.description: Only contacts that first appeared this way: `inbound` (they messaged this number), `outbound` (this number messaged them), `mention` (named in a group message) or `self` (the number's own contact card).
source.title: Source
